fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-10-03, Harish Selvam, aged 56, could not be traced after leaving home for a local errand; the last sighting was near Nallur Puram Market Road in Chennai. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-09-30 at roughly 18:15. The complaint was lodged by Tamilarasan Karuppasamy (9000000425), a family member of Harish Selvam, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000205. Madhan Babu, reachable on 9000000490, was named as someone who may have spoken to the missing person recently. The complainant mentioned photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Person reportedly left the residence and could not be contacted afterwards.
fields.Keywords: missing person, adult, suspect, market road, mobile number, photograph, evening
